reason: The first reading left the ordinals of the numbered questions, the hospital question and many line ends unresolved; the edition showed where to reread and the rereading corrected them.
sources: Henricus de Segusio (Hostiensis), Summa aurea, Turin: heirs of Nicolaus Bevilaqua, 1579, fol. 213v-214r (Internet Archive ARes01409, scan leaves n425-n426), page images
text:
SOURCE-ASSISTED READING, F-zms8. Reread on the images with the Turin 1579 edition of Hostiensis, Summa aurea, at hand: canvas 0 right column lines 1-27 and the hospital question; canvas 0 left column, twelve lines at "septimodecimo"; canvas 1 right column, about thirty lines from "Terciodecimo"; canvas 1 left column, last twelve lines. All else rests on the image-only first reading. Parentheses expand abbreviations; (?) marks uncertainty; [..] marks loss.

[Tr]actatu(m) e(st) s. de cl(er)icis secularib(us) [e]t eor(um) rebus nu(n)c subicitur de [r]egularibus et de his q(ue) p(er)tine(n)t ad [r]egulares. uideamus ergo. Quis sit regularis. et unde dicatur. ad quid teneatur. Et qualit(er) obligetur. Et utrum exire possit. u(e)l reuocari.
Quis sit r(e)g(u)l(a)ris. Is qui p(er) emissione(m) [margin: p(ro)fessio(n)is] u(e)l deuoc(i)o(n)e(m) pat(er)na(m) p(re)lati imp(er)io subicitur. q(uia) monachu(m) fac(it) aut p(ro)p(r)ia professio aut pat(er)na deuoc(i)o seq(ue)nti ratih(ab)ic(i)o(n)e ut i(nfra) e. cum sim(us). et c. porrectum. et c. cu(m) uiru(m). q(uo)d dic ut no. i(nfra) e. § et utru(m). v(er). si igitur. ergo(?) r(e)g(u)l(a)ris e(st) qui e(st) ad uiuendum r(e)g(ulari)t(er) astrictus siue sit monachus siue canonicus regularis qui et si [gap] s(an)c(t)or(um) monachor(um) co(n)sorcio no(n) putetur e(ss)e iu(n)ctus(?) s(er)uit(?) t(ame)n regule laxiori. i(nfra) de statu mo. q(uo)d dei timorem. i(n) multis au(tem) eor(um) concordat co(n)dic(i)o. i(nfra) ne cl(er)i. u(e)l mo. ex p(ar)te. et c. sup(er) specula. xx. q. iii. p(re)sens. s. de postul. ex p(ar)te. et h(oc) siue sit cl(er)icus siue laycus. na(m) et(?) tal(is) licet no(n) possit recipi in canonicu(m). s. de instit. c. ii. tame(n) pot(est) recipi i(n) co(n)u(er)sum. et ex quo p(ro)fess(us) e(st) reg(u)laris p(otest) dici. xxvii. q. i. ut lex. u(e)l religios(us). ut s. de constit. ecc(lesi)a. s. de reb(us) ec. no(n) al. c. fi. secus in no(n) p(ro)fessis q(ui) p(ro)p(r)ium retine(n)t. xix. q. ii.(?) § eco(ntra) paul(us). u(e)l in domo p(ro)p(r)ia remane(n)t. i(nfra) de p(ri)uil(e)g. cum et plantare. § de (con)fr(atr)ib(us) et c. ut p(ri)uil(eg)ia. § i. set et largo mo(do) d(icitu)r religios(us) qui i(n) domo p(ro)p(r)ia s(an)c(t)e et religiose uiuit. l(ice)t no(n) sit p(ro)fessus. xxxiii. q. v. q(uo)d d(e)o pa(t)ri. et dicitur tal(is) religios(us) no(n) i(de)o q(uod)
